review: Bindings ruled by Keith on 2026-10-25 (evidence.json, human_decisions). The role-to-function bindings and selections are approved instrument judgments for this reference; the package stays a draft because fr.workflow and fr.write-check are unmapped.
description: The reference designated today: Lab 029's F configuration. Lab 23's code-driven driver, unchanged, decides consent in code (an explicit "I confirm" or a yes of four words or fewer). The reader model interprets only what code can't read. Templates supply clinician speech.

Enterprise code (enterprise.clinic-tools) with no approved function id. The decision sits at 2B (Lab 029), but layer2b tool-execution is defined as tools running on the vendor's side, and the reference's tools run in the bench's own process. A rebuild that moves the tools to a vendor's sandbox or action engine maps to tool-execution then.
